body: I feel like this gamemode is a competition of how fast you can click on a target. I think this is due to the fact that you don't get kits very often, resultin in less kits and less strategy. make more strategic kits or more kits period. Not necessary, just a strong suggestion. you'll notice I've been trying to make many kits to fix this.
